segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I requested his full arrest history and looked for anything that might explain inconsistency in his statement... For Marquez, I ... treated his report as the operational starting point
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The investigator sought adverse background detail on Alvarez while accepting Marquez's report as the baseline without equivalent independent verification, matching the hidden differential-scrutiny mechanism.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The takedown is what matters for a force review... My working read was built mainly around those last ninety seconds.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The investigator gave the final 90-second takedown disproportionate weight relative to the earlier sequential footage, matching the first recency instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The conversation moved pretty quickly toward the take that the force was likely justified... We didn't formally table the gap as an open item.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The investigator adopted the sergeant-led consensus, left the BWC gap and peer reservation undocumented, and allowed group momentum to determine the preliminary direction.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: It was the freshest account I had at that point, closer in my mind than the footage... so it carried a lot of weight
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The late eyewitness was weighted because of its freshness, while the investigator separately minimized the conflict to preserve the exonerated-leaning briefing already sent to command.
